rationale: With only 9 minutes remaining until the close, the risk of forced liquidation at the market price outweighs the potential for a meaningful intraday move, particularly given the stock's high volatility (19% range) and the fact that it is trading below its session VWAP. The recent stabilization above the 9-EMA is insufficient to justify entering a new position with such limited time to reach a take-profit target before the automatic close-out.
